k2315d96d: [ابت The beta distribution is the conjugate prior to the binomial distribution: Beta(a, b) and s successes in n trials give Beta(a + s, b + n − s). The posterior mean (a + s) : (a + b + n) is a weighted mean of prior mean a : (a + b) and share s : n, with the weights a + b and n. Beta(1, 1) is the uniform distribution. The choice of the prior, too, is a decision that belongs fixed beforehand and reported openly (sensitivity analysis with a second prior). The inference to the probability of a hypothesis after the data is available only through Bayes' theorem with a prior probability; in diagnostics the prior corresponds to the prevalence and the posterior to the predictive value. تبا]

k41cc4278: [ابت Mauchly's test checks whether sphericity holds. With small groups it often overlooks a violation, with large ones it fires even at tiny deviations. Better is the continuous measure epsilon: it is 1 when sphericity is met and becomes smaller the more unequal the variances of the differences are. The degrees of freedom of the F test are multiplied by epsilon: with epsilon 0.70 and 2 and 20 degrees of freedom the test uses 1.4 and 14. That makes it more cautious, but without a jump at a threshold. تبا]

k4736e251: [ابت Distance counts every unit equally. In the training data body mass has a standard deviation of 786.4 g, bill depth one of 2.01 mm. Standardised (each variable divided by its standard deviation) the contributions are 0.99 and 0.016; now the difference in bill depth counts, because it is large relative to the usual spread. Without standardising, the three nearest neighbours of the penguin above all weigh exactly 3450 g; their bill depth (19.0, 18.8 and 18.6 mm) only counts when the mass is the same. k5de670c5: [ابت The p value tests the whole statistical model, including random sampling or randomisation and the assumption that the analysis was not chosen after the result. For a given sample size a p threshold is at the same time a minimum effect size: with 60 people in total the two-sided threshold of 5% corresponds to a correlation of r = 0.254. The inference from "p small" to "H₀ improbable" is formally invalid, because P(H₀ | data) is sought but P(data | H₀) is delivered; the reversal requires Bayes' theorem and a prior probability. Alternatives and complements: estimation with intervals, Bayes factors, likelihood ratios. تبا]

ka1605226: [ابت Repeated-measures analysis of variance compares the means of the time points. The growth curve model (latent growth model, LGM) asks differently: how does the development go for each individual person? It places a line through each person's measurements with two characteristics: the intercept (the starting value at time value 0) and the slope (the change per time unit). Both are called "latent" because they are not measured but inferred from the measurements. The model estimates the mean of intercept and slope over all people, their variation between people and the relationship of the two. تبا]

ka4cf90bd: [ابت The ordinary standard error of a regression assumes that every row brings new, independent information. If the same firm was measured for 20 years, the 20 rows bring less new information than 20 different firms: one year resembles the next. The standard error is then too small, p values too small, intervals too narrow. A cluster-robust standard error treats each unit as one block ("cluster") and allows the rows within a block to be related in any way. Between the blocks independence remains the assumption. تبا]

kbb0a3312: [ابت Cronbach's α sums up how strongly the answers to the questions are related on average, and it rises with the number of questions. It estimates reliability well only if the questions measure a single thing, contribute equally to it and do not additionally resemble each other through wording or order; otherwise it can come out too high or too low. A factor analysis checks whether the questions measure one thing; alpha does not show whether the scale measures what is meant (validity). The reliability holds for this group of people, not for the questionnaire as such. تبا]

kbe1f34bc: [ابت A regression asks: how does the outcome change when the cause changes? That is only right if the cause is not itself co-determined by the outcome or by something unmeasured. With the price of a good this is hard: when many people buy, the price rises, and when the price rises, fewer buy. Both at once cannot be separated in the data; the price is then called endogenous (co-determined from within). An instrument is a variable from outside: it shifts the price without touching demand itself. The two-stage calculation (2SLS) takes two steps: first the price is predicted from the instrument (first stage), then the calculation continues with this "cleaned" price (second stage). تبا]

kc277641f: [ابت Two questions come first with panel data. First: do the units differ at all? The F test for unit effects checks this: it compares the model that treats every unit alike (pooled) with the fixed-effects model. Second: are random effects enough, or are fixed ones needed? The Hausman test compares the two estimates: if they lie far apart, the assumption of random effects is doubtful and you take fixed effects. تبا]

kc58c66ff: [ابت A measure hits one group (the treated), another it does not (the comparison group). Both are measured before and after. The change of the treated alone says little, because something changes over time even without the measure. The comparison group shows roughly how much. So the change of the comparison group is subtracted from the change of the treated: the difference of the differences (difference-in-differences). This holds only under one assumption: without the measure both groups would have moved in parallel (parallel trends). With one point in time before, it cannot be checked from the data, only argued. تبا]

kd6c2a456: [ابت Statable runs PSPP commands, not SPSS scripts: an .sps file runs on the "Commands" page as far as PSPP knows the commands; Python programs and SPSS extensions do not run. PSPP cannot do GLM with WITH (analysis of covariance) or NONPAR CORR (Spearman); for these Statable has the questions "Do groups differ?" (with a control variable under "More options") and "Are two things related?". PSPP also cannot do PARTIAL CORR, CLUSTER, MIXED, NOMREG, PLUM, MVA, GRAPH /LINE, REPORT and other SPSS commands; the message names the matching question in Statable or says honestly that it does not exist yet. Typical stumbling blocks in course files: Statable skips GET FILE and GET DATA with a file path (open the data first, then run the commands); SAVE OUTFILE and EXPORT produce no file (to save: page "Data", "Export data"); Statable does not show charts from commands (they are on the sheet of the matching question); Python blocks (BEGIN PROGRAM) are skipped. تبا]

kdcdfc678: [ابت With a group column Statable compares the groups as SPSS does by Wilcoxon (Gehan), approximately: the time of each case is replaced by the start of its interval, and with equal times "event shorter than censored" applies. The result is a χ² with (groups − 1) degrees of freedom; with more than two groups the pairs with Holm adjustment are shown beside it. The test is the generalisation of the Wilcoxon rank-sum test to censored times (Gehan 1965), not the ordinary rank-sum test. It weights early events more strongly than the log-rank test and depends on the pattern of censoring; with very different censoring in the groups (more than 20 percentage points) Statable warns. Which of the two tests to use should be decided before looking at the data. تبا]

ke343d201: [ابت One-sided, p = P(X ≥ x) or P(X ≤ x). Two-sided, Statable doubles the smaller one-sided value: p = min(1; 2 · min(P(X ≤ x), P(X ≥ x))). R (binom.test) calculates two-sided differently (sum of all probabilities that are at most as large as P(X = x)); for p₀ ≠ 0.5 the p value can be smaller there. CFI and TLI from 0.95, RMSEA up to 0.06 and SRMR up to 0.08 are rules of thumb (Hu & Bentler 1999, Structural Equation Modeling 6, 1-55).
